name: Xfinity Military Program
description: Free mobile line for 2 years, Diamond membership with Peacock Premium, and 1 year of NOW TV
fullDescription: Xfinity offers exclusive benefits for military members, veterans, and their families, including a free mobile line for 2 years, Peacock Premium, and a year of NOW TV.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free Xfinity Mobile Select line for 2 years (requires Xfinity Internet)
- Additional mobile lines from $30/month
- Mobile-only access fee waived if you move where Xfinity Internet isn't available
- Automatic upgrade to Xfinity Diamond membership
- Peacock Premium included for Diamond members
- NOW TV free for 1 year (125+ live channels plus On Demand)
howToGetIt:
1. Visit xfinity.com/learn/deals/military
2. Sign in with your Xfinity ID (new customers sign up for service first)
3. Verify your military status online
4. Eligible: active and Reserve members of the U.S. uniformed services, retired military, veterans, Gold Star families, and family members in the same household
5. Diamond upgrade and NOW TV take up to 10 days; mobile discount shows within 1-2 billing cycles
6. Questions about verification: call 1-833-231-6446
keywords: Xfinity, Comcast, military discount, veteran, Gold Star families, internet, TV, mobile, Peacock, NOW TV
